description: The one busy indicator for the whole system: a rotating loader icon. Inline by default (sits next to text or inside a button); center it with the layout around it. Animation is paused under prefers-reduced-motion (reset.css).
example:
/* `label` is the accessible name a screen reader announces — a spinner
 * without one is a silent "something is happening". Inline by default; the
 * layout around it does the centering. */

<Spinner label="Loading your workspace" />
